messages:
sam: quick sync: we saw tail spikes in the Dedicated canary from concurrent migrations. propose two additions: a resident reservation window per-route, and coalesced-aligned migrations to reduce fragmentation.

maya: resident window sounds good. for chat flows a 3-5s window keeps follow-ups warm without huge memory tax.

indra: coalesced alignment is key. if migrations carve out arbitrary small blocks we end up with uncoalescable holes. require migration allocations to round up to slab size (e.g. 4MB).

lee: developer UX: expose route metadata via console + SDK. example YAML: 
```yaml
route: /v1/complete
metadata:
  resident_reserve_ms: 5000
  resident_priority: 40
  align_to_slab: true
```

sam: also proposing a soft quota charge for reservations (counts against tenant memory usage) so tenants don't reserve unlimited resident bytes.

indra: telemetry we'll add: `host.pool.free_pct`, `migrate.concurrent`, `alloc.coalescable_pct`, and `route.fallback_quality_delta`. Auto-disable fallback if delta > 2%.

maya: edge case: what if slab rounding pushes a migration above tenant quota? we should fail the reservation rather than evict unrelated tenants. fail-fast and surface to console.

lee: rollout plan: feature flag -> 10% canary -> metrics check -> gradual. infra-bot can kick off deploy.

infra-bot: deploy/scheduled resident-window-coalesce-v1 to pool canary-09 (10% traffic)

sam: ok filing RFC update + small console PR. thanks. :thumbsup:
